parameters.name: CloudProvider
parameters.description: The cloud service provider.

parameters.name: ConnectionString
parameters.description: The database endpoint.

parameters.name: DBClusterDescription
parameters.description: The description of the cluster. Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: DBClusterIds
parameters.description: The cluster ID. To specify multiple cluster IDs, separate them with commas (,).

parameters.name: DBClusterStatus
parameters.description: The status of the cluster.

parameters.name: DBNodeIds
parameters.description: The node ID. You can specify multiple node IDs. Separate them with commas (,).

parameters.name: DBType
parameters.description:
The database type. Valid values:

- MySQL

- PostgreSQL

- Oracle

parameters.name: DBVersion
parameters.description: The database version.

parameters.name: DescribeType
parameters.description: The query mode. Set the value to \`Simple\`. In this mode, only the basic metadata of the clusters is returned.

parameters.name: Expired
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the cluster has expired. Valid values:

- true

- false

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return for the current request. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: A token used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the \`NextToken\` value returned from the previous API call. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.

Default value: 30.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:

- Postpaid: pay-as-you-go

- Prepaid: subscription

parameters.name: RecentCreationInterval
parameters.description: Filters for clusters created in the last N days. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: RecentExpirationInterval
parameters.description: Filters for clusters that expire in N days. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of tag \`n\`. You can filter clusters by specifying up to 20 tags. The \`n\` must be a unique and consecutive integer that starts from 1. \`Tag.n.Key\` corresponds to \`Tag.n.Value\`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the tag key.
